description: Context for a brand's most recently observed locations: event timing, address/market, traffic counts when backfilled, route class, trade-area demographics, radius demographics, drive-time context, and coverage flags. Useful for questions like 'traffic counts for the last 50 Starbucks locations CREHQ observed.' Event rows distinguish verified openings from first-observed/reconciliation events.

country.description: ISO country code filter (default all available rows).

event_type.description: Lifecycle event type to use for recency (default first_observed).

only_with_traffic.description: When true, return only recent rows with traffic/AADT attached.

name: crehq_recent_location_context
